title: Number of Valid Subarrays
goal: Count subarrays whose first value is no greater than every later value in that subarray.
strategy: For each starting index, the first strictly smaller value ends its valid range. A nondecreasing stack waits for that boundary; equal values do not end a range.

edgeCases: Equal values never violate the first-value condition
A decreasing array permits only singleton ranges
An increasing array permits every subarray
